properties.name: glint.diagnostics
properties.description: Mount the /_vt diagnostics dashboard and related JSON APIs. Virtual threads are always enabled for accepted connections.

properties.name: glint.static.enabled
properties.description: Serve static files directly from Glint, before the servlet filter chain and Spring MVC.

properties.name: glint.static.prefix
properties.description: URL prefix of the static mount, for example /assets.

properties.name: glint.static.location
properties.description: Directory path, or classpath:some/root for classpath resources. Required when glint.static.enabled=true.

properties.name: glint.static.cache-max-entry-bytes
properties.description: Files up to this size are cached in memory (0 disables the cache). Directory mounts only.

properties.name: glint.static.cache-max-total-bytes
properties.description: Upper bound for cached bytes of the mount. Directory mounts only.

properties.name: glint.static.revalidate-millis
properties.description: How long cached file metadata is trusted before re-checking the filesystem. Directory mounts only.

properties.name: glint.static.cache-control
properties.description: Cache-Control header for non-fingerprinted files (fingerprinted names get immutable caching); unset sends none. Directory mounts only.

properties.name: glint.static.precompressed
properties.description: Serve precompressed .br / .gz siblings when the client accepts them. Directory mounts only.

properties.name: glint.static.directory-listing
properties.description: Render an HTML/JSON listing for directories without index.html. Directory mounts only.

properties.name: glint.access-log.enabled
properties.description: Write one access log line per request to stdout.

properties.name: glint.access-log.format
properties.description: Access log format: text or json (JSON Lines).

properties.name: glint.cors.enabled
properties.description: Apply Glint-level CORS headers to every response, including static files and diagnostics.

properties.name: glint.cors.allowed-origin
properties.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin value: * or one exact origin.

properties.name: glint.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Access-Control-Allow-Methods for preflight responses.

properties.name: glint.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Access-Control-Allow-Headers for preflight responses.

properties.name: glint.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: Access-Control-Expose-Headers on actual responses.

properties.name: glint.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Send Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

properties.name: glint.cors.max-age-seconds
properties.description: Access-Control-Max-Age for preflight responses.

properties.name: glint.cors.short-circuit-options
properties.description: Answer preflight OPTIONS requests with 204 without reaching Spring.

properties.name: glint.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Per-client-IP token bucket; excess requests get 429 with Retry-After. /_vt diagnostics are exempt.

properties.name: glint.rate-limit.permits-per-second
properties.description: Sustained refill rate per client IP.

properties.name: glint.rate-limit.burst
properties.description: Bucket capacity per client IP.

values.description: JSON Lines with ts, method, path, status, durationMs, bytes, remote
